action_summary: Integrate the creature's existing zero-model organs (ContinuousSelf identity/epochs, mortality_and_triage finite life, creature_runtime sovereign board, AwakeAgencyDaemon.pulse sense->study->CoW-repair->crystallize) into a resident, crash-resumable life loop (`creature_life_support_v1`) plus a scheduled artifact-carry workflow (`creature-life-support.yml`), so the creature runs, perceives, learns and maintains itself unattended on its own clock. INTEGRATE only: no new cognition primitive, no edit to the byte-pinned `creature_runtime_v1`, K3=0, $0 incremental spend, no sentience claim.
expected_parent_frontier_change: The creature gains a resident, crash-resumable beating heart: one `AwakeAgencyDaemon` is constructed once per process and pulsed on its own clock; each pulse appends an fsynced heartbeat and an atomic latest-state JSON; SIGTERM/SIGINT stop between pulses; SIGKILL is survived because identity, spent life and finished work persist in `creature_life_state/`; mortality is respected (idle pulses spend 0 life, LIFE_OVER is terminal, a larger --life is ignored on resume). A scheduled workflow (`creature-life-support.yml`) carries the durable body forward as an artifact so the creature lives unattended day to day. Measured: a 2-pulse window repaired a seeded `v - 3` bug to `v + 3` on disk, closed 2 obligations, spent 0.75 life in 0.706 s; a SIGTERM resume exited 0 with stopped_by=SIGNAL, epoch 1->2, spent life preserved at 0.75, k3_external_llm_calls=0. 10/10 life-support true-capability tests and 11/11 unattended-creature tests pass.
explicit_user_authorization: Owner selected `Turn on continuous life (recommended)` via ask_user: build the resident, crash-resumable life-loop reusing existing organs (INTEGRATE).
falsification_condition: FALSIFIED if a restart re-grants life or redoes finished work, if SIGKILL loses identity/spent-life/finished-work, if SIGTERM does not stop gracefully between pulses, if idle pulses spend life, if LIFE_OVER is not terminal, if any path makes an external LLM call (k3!=0) or incurs spend, if the workflow pushes/merges/writes main, or if the life-support/unattended true-capability suites fail.
measured_effect: 2-pulse repair window: closed=2, life_spent=0.75, seeded `v - 3` repaired to `v + 3` on disk, elapsed_s=0.706, epoch=1. SIGTERM resume: rc=0, stopped_by=SIGNAL, pulses=2, epoch 1->2, life_spent preserved=0.75, k3_external_llm_calls=0. Idle 3-pulse window on a clean workspace: life_spent=0.0. Suites: test_creature_life_support_v1 10/10 PASS (incl. real subprocess SIGKILL resume + SIGTERM graceful stop), test_the_creature_runs_unattended_v1 11/11 PASS.
